notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.10: Faster matches, cheaper items and a new skin.
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, long time no see. We're back at it again here with many incrimental updates to game play design and content in the pipeline. Starting off with big balance changes and a new skin in 0.9.10

[h1]Gameplay Changes:[/h1]
We decided to up the ante for matches. Creeps are faster and more resilient while towers have become more deadly. This should significantly reduce average match length. The following changes change the effectivness of all towers. We appreciate your help with balance feedback following this update. Thank you!
[list]
[*]Creeps spawn 20% faster thus match rounds will be about that much faster.
[*]Creep Move Speed increased by 20% further shortening round time.
[*]Creep Armor base increased by 2.
[*]Tower Damage increased by 20%
[*]Tower Attack Speed increaded by 10%
[*]Hydron Tower Damage bonus decreased by 10% to lower it's benefit from enemy creep speed.(Hydron still technically received a buff from this update)
[*]Particle Tower Attack Speed increased by 10% to further compensate the new creep speed.
[/list]

[h1]Store and Economy Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]All items in the store seeds and kindling costs have been drastically reduced by 18%-66%
[*]Skins can now be purchased with Seeds as well as Kindling.
[*]Achievement seed rewards increased by 25 each. Match Seed rewards have been slightly decreased.
[/list]

[h1]Introducing Sauté Sands[/h1]
A new skin to choose from. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18998959/eaf277a7a9fcc1b5a1d6ea041a3aabd6e39b8f39.png[/img]

[h1]In the pipeline for future updates[/h1]
Looking forward to delivering these changes in future updates on a more frequent basis.
[list]
[*]More Skins! We have a bunch of skins in the works which we will introduce packaged with other new content.
[*]Round Ready button: When both players click "Ready!" the round will start skipping the 45sec timer.
[*]Widescreen resolution and larger battlefield areas. We are expanding the playfield!
[*]New tower set in the works. Coming soon!
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.09: New Heartburn and Rekindle Creeps Available!
notes.content:
Hey it's been a while. Minor bug fixes and the new Heartburn Set is available on the in game store!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18998959/f7bd4617f10ed164d8e0e4387effe3647b906a8c.png[/img]

Heartburn has an undying spirit, regenorating a significant portion of health after taking fire. Kill them quickly...or you won't be able to!

Rekindle refuses to give up. Upon death they leave behind a coal statue which bursts back to life with increased movespeed and determination after a few seconds.

We think players will be able to incorporate these into their attack strategies nicely, let me know how balanced they are in the discuessions.

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.08 NEW TUTORIAL / CAMPAIGN
notes.content:
Completely new tutorial which makes up the first (and currently only) mission of the campaign. Please replay the tutorial and let me know if you find a bug you might also learn something you didn't catch in the old one.

Also fixed some game crashing bugs people were having using certain creeps.

I've also been working on a new Tower Set and Creep Set with Brian which will be included int he next Patch 0.9.09. Check the Discussion boards for more details on that.

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.07 STABILITY
notes.content:
I worked on the server a lot. It seems to be pretty stable, but the real test starts now. Please leave issues in my pinned discussion, thanks!

Using a better compiler, I'm seeing a 20% frame rate performance increase, I hope it's the same or better for you all.

Changed: The default map for matchmaking, mixing it up. You can still choose any of the three maps when inviting a friend to play with you.

Added: a message signifying the server is waiting for the other player to finish watching the waves before bringing you back to the build phase.

Hopefully from here we can get back to adding features!

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.06 STABILITY
notes.content:
This is just a stability patch, no game play changes have been made. Please restart steam to trigger the update. 

Fixed: Lobby menu navigation.
Switching between menus should be more reliable now.

Added: Streamlined Tutorial
The tutorial should be easier to get through now, an arrow depicts where the player should be focusing at all times. 

Fixed: login and account creation. 
This should work well now. Let me know if there are issues, thanks.

Added: Server stability
Made changes to the way the game communicates with the server, this should help players with slower computers stay connected to the game. 
Let me know in the bugs section if you have any issues.

tags.feature: Added: Streamlined Tutorial
Added: Server stability

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.03 AUTO LOGIN IS HERE
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience while we worked things out with account creation. You might need to restart steam to trigger the update.

Patch Notes 0.9.03

[b]Added: Auto login:[/b]
Steam will now auto log you in once you have created an account and logged in once before. You must answer yes when the game asks you to link steam to your account after logging in for this to work.

[b]Fixed: Friends list:[/b]
The social button is now active in the lobby. You an add friends using their fwf username(not steam name) and invite them to a match. 
There are 3 arenas with diferent layouts to choose from when inviting a friend. I plan on adding more functionallity with steam in regards to managing friends later. 

[b]Fixed: Changing skins bug[/b]
You can now correctly change your arena skin from the profile menu after buying one in the store. 

[b]Fixed: Login issues[/b]
Made changes to the account creation. For details and if you are still having trouble logging in, visit this thread for instructions.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/351630/discussions/0/371918937263202364/

[b]Game Changes[/b]
Increased Creep HP per level by another 3% compounded.
